terry_instructions: On a tripod phone camera, film a steady wide shot of your hands unpacking chickpeas, lemon, celery, red onion, mayo, and tortillas from a plain paper bag beside a bowl and your open laptop.
caption: SousSight: Counter Intelligence
voiceover: A food pantry hands you chickpeas, a lemon and tortillas. Getting the food is half of dinner. Cooking it shouldn't take an unlimited data plan, or streaming your kitchen to the cloud.

caption: An AI sous-chef for pantry cooks
voiceover: This is SousSight.

caption: Type what's in the bag
voiceover: I type what's in the bag and tap Find my meal.

terry_instructions: On desktop Chrome (D1) via OBS or QuickTime, capture the full screen showing the macOS Wi-Fi icon visibly connected while you tap Find my meal in a clean Chrome profile.
caption: Wi-Fi on, running on-device
voiceover: Wi-Fi is on, and Firebase AI Logic still runs this

caption: Chrome built-in Gemini Nano
voiceover: on Chrome's built-in Gemini Nano.

caption: On this device · Gemini Nano
voiceover: That badge, "On this device", isn't a setting. It's what the SDK reported.

caption: Confirm items and allergy check
voiceover: I confirm my items, pick the chickpea wrap and answer the allergy check. Nothing counts until I tap it.

terry_instructions: On the tripod phone camera, film a close counter cutaway of your hands putting sliced red onion into a small cup with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
caption: Quick-pickle the red onion
voiceover: Step one: the onion pickles for five minutes,

caption: Real 5-minute timer running
voiceover: so I start a real timer and move on.

caption: Camera only, no mic, no live stream
voiceover: While it runs, I tap Watch my food. Camera only: no microphone, no live stream. Each frame is checked on this laptop.

terry_instructions: On the tripod phone camera, film your hands mashing chickpeas in the bowl with a fork, then holding one hand flat over the bowl in front of the laptop webcam.
caption: Hand over bowl to test watch
voiceover: When my hand blocks the bowl, it doesn't guess.

caption: Unsure? It asks. It doesn't guess.
voiceover: It says it's unsure and asks for a better view. And it never calls food done or safe. That's my call.

terry_instructions: On desktop Chrome (D1) via OBS or QuickTime, click Wi-Fi off in the macOS menu bar so the app shows its offline status while the onion timer keeps ticking.
caption: Wi-Fi off. Still cooking.
voiceover: Now the Wi-Fi drops, which in a lot of kitchens is just Tuesday.

caption: Offline step help on-device
voiceover: I ask anyway: how smooth should this be?

caption: On this device: Coach Lite answers
voiceover: Coach Lite answers on the device: chunky, like tuna salad, a few whole chickpeas are fine. My onion timer is still running.

caption: AI requests stayed on this device
voiceover: What was sent? Scan, watch, coaching: every one of those AI requests ran on this device. And it's honest about the rest: my cooking session is saved, so I can pick it up later.

terry_instructions: On desktop Chrome (D1) via OBS or QuickTime, turn Wi-Fi back on in the macOS menu bar, tap Research a cooking question, and submit "Can I use Greek yogurt instead of mayo?"
caption: Wi-Fi back on for web research
voiceover: Wi-Fi back on. Some questions need the web. Can I use Greek yogurt instead of mayo?

terry_instructions: On desktop Chrome (D1) via OBS or QuickTime, show the Cloud · Gemini research answer with clickable Google Search sources, then tap What was sent to display the single new row under Reported as sent.
caption: Cloud only when it earns it
voiceover: That one goes to Gemini in the cloud, grounded with Google Search, with sources I can open. The badge says Cloud, and the ledger has one new entry.

caption: One hybrid bridge, one policy
voiceover: Flutter has no hybrid API, so we bridged Firebase AI Logic's web, Android and Apple SDKs behind one policy.

caption: Keep on this device switches
voiceover: The cloud is used only when the device can't do the job, this build allows it, and my switches say yes.

terry_instructions: On the tripod phone camera, film a warm counter shot of your hands rolling the chickpea salad into a tortilla and slicing it cleanly in half.
caption: Wrap rolled, dinner's ready
voiceover: Wrap's rolled.

terry_instructions: On desktop Chrome (D1) via OBS or QuickTime, tap Text the household: dinner is ready on the meal-complete screen and hold clearly on the Simulated — no SMS sent review sheet.
caption: Simulated — no SMS sent
voiceover: Dinner's ready, and the household text is simulated for judging.

title.sub: Built with Firebase AI Logic · github.com/terryhh/SousSight

voiceover: SousSight watches your counter on your device, and the cloud only comes to dinner when it earns a seat.
